name: install_url
title: Install a package from a url

origin.description: Download each url and install the source package with R CMD INSTALL.
origin.usage: install_url(url, subdir = NULL, dependencies = NA, upgrade = c("default", "ask", "always", "never"), quiet = FALSE, build = TRUE, ...)

arguments.name: url
arguments.text: URL of a source tarball or zip. file:// is accepted. Several urls are installed in order.

arguments.name: subdir
arguments.text: Subdirectory of the archive that contains the package.

arguments.name: build
arguments.text: When TRUE, run R CMD build before install.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: RemoteType url is written into DESCRIPTION. The remote sha is missing, so the package is installed again on the next call.
origin.value: The package name, or a character vector of names.
origin.example: install_url(url, dependencies = FALSE, upgrade = "never", quiet = TRUE, build = FALSE, lib = lib)

translation.description: Download each url and install the source package with R CMD INSTALL.
translation.usage: install_url(url, subdir=None, dependencies=NA, upgrade='default', quiet=False, build=True, lib=None)

arguments.name: url
arguments.text: One URL or a list. A .tar.gz extension is kept intact.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: The bundle is downloaded with urllib and installed with R CMD INSTALL into lib. A check uses a fresh temporary library and does not write to ~/R/library. Directory members of a tarball are recorded with a trailing slash before the package root is chosen.
translation.example: install_url(url, dependencies=False, upgrade="never", quiet=True, build=False, lib=lib)
